requirement: bml-inference-pipeline 8.6 (complete in-memory causal arithmetic; persisted/AOT symbolic compilation remains open)
profile: Experimental F64 BML activation arithmetic with F32 KV storage; no native arithmetic fallback.

fixture.properties: Nonzero Q/K/V, adjacent-pair RoPE at different positions, nonzero gate/down and negative up weights, learned normalization and vocabulary projection weights.

verification.oracle: Independent fixed-size complete model evaluator, using no production projection/normalization/rotary/attention/activation helpers; native comparison is additional evidence.
verification.mlp_sensitivity: Independent logits with and without MLP differ by more than 1e-6 in every tested prefix.
verification.program_policy: Every compiled output program is checked against One/Var/Const/Bml and stack instructions; native arithmetic opcodes are rejected.
verification.cache: Prefill plus incremental decode matches the full-prefix oracle. A late program-budget failure leaves the committed position unchanged, and another instance with the same source successfully retries on that cache.
verification.failure_cases: Node/opcode/program budgets, invalid token/context/layout, and a finite native input rejected by symbolic numerical range are explicit errors.

limitations: Kernels are compiled lazily and retained in memory; no persisted symbolic AOT artifact or CLI profile is claimed.
The legacy scalar build_transformer_dag is not replaced by this work.
Only a small F32 GGUF fixture is validated; no large-model numerical stability, capacity or performance claim.
The hot loop retains IEEE semantics. Finite outputs do not certify every intermediate in the strict real domain.
The host performs embedding lookup, row decode, metadata/position constant precomputation and F32 KV storage.
Separate output programs duplicate shared DAG work; scalability remains pending.
